added.summary: `box-decoration-break` (CSS Fragmentation 3 §5.4) on a text a multi-column break splits: `slice`, the initial value, draws its background, border and shadows as one unbroken box cut at the break, each piece showing its part in its own column; `clone` gives each piece its own whole box, with padding and border at the break taken into the column balancing. A split text drew one box for its first piece only, with a border at the break, and none in the next column.
